paragraphs.text: Pako is a monstrous Elemental Dog from Ikoria . Its bonder is Haldan .

The carefree bonder, Haldan, and his canine monster friend, Pako, travel all across Ikoria, searching out crystals with unusual properties. Pako is able to sniff out strange and powerful crystals for Haldan to study and experiment with, and Haldan makes sure he always has a special treat on hand for his devoted friend. He carries a rounded stone club.
